introHtml: Red sticky notes flags are a go-to choice for drawing immediate attention to critical information in documents, reports, or presentations. Whether your team uses them to flag action items, compliance updates, or safety reminders, the bold color ensures nothing gets overlooked. Perfect for bulk orders, these flags can be customized with your logo or message using full-color print, making them a practical giveaway for trade shows or office supply kits.
